scientific_integrity: Infinite statements proved by run classification and elementary balanced optimization. Finite tests are independent consistency checks, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four nonempty circular runs; balanced corollary requires equal symbol counts. Previously known sharp examples are credited to the 2004/2005 geometric work. No claim for unrestricted numbers of runs; unindexed equivalent specializations remain a residual novelty risk.
title: Exact cyclic antipalindromic subsequences in four-run binary words
